Citation generator

Paste paper links, get ready-to-post APA citations with the hashtag, trimmed to fit Bluesky.

How it works

Metadata comes from Crossref, which covers journals, bioRxiv and the newer openRxiv DOIs. Paste DOIs or article URLs, one per line — the DOI is pulled out of the URL automatically, and PMC links are resolved through NCBI first.

Paste the generated text into the Bluesky composer with the full URL — the composer shortens it for display, which is what the character count already assumes.

Set the hashtag per paper with the dropdown on each row.
